company_info.company_description: "Venergy is a trusted name in Australia's solar industry, helping households and businesses reduce energy costs and achieve energy independence since 2009. With a strong track record in residential, commercial, and large-scale projects, Venergy focuses on premium products, affordable price, expert installations, and exceptional customer support.Owned/Managed By In-house Engineers & Electricians- Hands-on technical expertise and meticulous quality control.Trusted & Award-Winning- Preferred solar, battery and EV charger provider for the local governments.Quality You Can Rely On- We only install premium products from trusted brandsHonest & Transparent Approach- No pushy sales tactics - just expert advice tailored to your energy needs- Clear pricing and no hidden costsComprehensive Solar & Battery Solutions- Flexible finance options to make solar and battery systems affordable- Solutions for grid-connected solar, off-grid solar, and hybrid systemsVenergy Story:Venergy was founded in 2009 by Matthew Wilkins, an electrician from the Murraylands, South Australia. Working with local farmers, Matt developed a deep appreciation for hard work, integrity, and practical solutions - values that became the foundation of Venergy.Inspired by Matt’s connection to the farming community, Venergy follows the 'Grandma Theory': only install systems and use products he’d trust in his own grandma’s house. This principle ensures every customer receives safe, reliable, and high-quality solutions."

reviews.review_description: My choice of Venergy was due to these factors: glowing reviews on the internet, my trust in Solarquotes, competitive quote, and a bad impression left by another quoting company. It turned out to be a horrible experience. I can't discount what other customers said, so I guess I was just unlucky.My initial impression of Venergy was really good. The consultant was very friendly and responsive. He convinced me that they did not need a site inspection because they have Google maps and had done thousands of jobs in Victoria and even big commercial projects. The problem was they did not foresee the need of scaffolding, and Worksafe happened to be doing their rounds in the middle of the install. They were issued a stop work notice and the project was stalled. In the end I had a very unpleasant cost blowout and a delayed completion.Another unpleasant thing was I followed the advice I read on the Solarquotes website and asked for a cover for the inverter. The consultant did not say it would cost extra. He said no problem they would include it. When I found that it is not mentioned in the quote I raised the issue and he just kept saying to leave it with him. When the install team was here, I asked again and they said they heard nothing about it. I rang the consultant and he still said to leave it with him. After the installation was complete, I took this up with the manager. He said these things are not free. My question was if it wasn't free, why did the consultant offered to include it. He could have just quoted it and I could decide to have it or not have it. The manager said to leave it with him. It's now been a week and all I had was silence. I understand a cover is not absolutely necessary, but promises not kept just leave a really bad impression.Summary of my Venergy experience: Consultant needed constant chasing up for missing things. Over-promise and under-deliver. Install team were subcontractors but they were punctual, polite and tidy. However, so far I still haven't had instructions given to me after the installation. Sungrow does not really have helpful user manuals. (I found it in the app but it opened to nothing.) The contractor made an appointment to come back but did not show up. System and car charger is working but I relied on myself to install the app and figure out what everything means and how to charge the car. Retailer paper work and meter reconfiguration pending at this stage.

The person on phone was clear and supportive. I had the same person in contact throughout process, friendly and could answer all my questions.The team installing were helpful and followed through on everything they said they would. Also very friendly, punctual, all the aspects you’d hope for!The quote was comparable.Very happy

Overall a very professional installation.The sales consultant visited home and gave me explanations of the process followed up with the quote.The installation was very well done and the technicians were impressive with their skills handling the steep roofs.System now seems to be working well and the wifi app gives an interesting feedback on daily usage.V energy is highly recommended.
Best value:Overall value > System price and quality brand, supplier's positive online reviews, very knowledgeable and helpful sales personInstallation only booked for Nov 25.Yet to instal

Sales/quoting process well managed, clear and professional. Personal direct contact easy at any time.Could not fault the instal process - on time arrival, pleasant  and expert tradesmen, finished to schedule, site cleaned and equipment well located.Grid connection and instructions clear, at right level.Still awaiting regulator inspection/approval

I’m absolutely thrilled with the service from Venergy Solar, my trusted solar and battery supplier. With the guidance of Todd Gourley, the decision-making process was seamless. He provided the perfect solution for our needs and patiently addressed all my questions and concerns. The operations team, administration staff, and installers were all highly professional—delivering true “service with a smile.” If I had to do it all over again, I would still choose Venergy without hesitation. Thank you, Todd and the entire Venergy team!Thank you SolarQuotes for your referral, had it not been for you I wouldn't have found such a great team.

Helpful Salesman but still waiting on installation.Only one company bothered to contact me, but I was happy with price and liked the Salesperson.Paid deposit back in late July, now early September.A little poor with keeping me updated. Paid deposit back in late July, now early September.When I have called to ask for progress, I have had prompt responses.Still hopeful of receiving my battery.

I reported a 318 DC back current fault on my inverter that went unresolved for over 5 weeks, leading to a loss in solar generation. Initially, I was told delays were due to the workload from new battery installs, which made me feel that existing customers were not being prioritised.After raising my concerns, the CEO personally contacted me and arranged for an electrician to fix the fault the very next day. I genuinely appreciate the quick action and goodwill once it was escalated.Overall, I’m satisfied with the outcome and hope Venergy continues to improve their after-sales support so customers receive timely service without needing to escalate issues.

I highly recommend Venergy Solar to anyone thinking about going Solar. Great to deal with a company that strives for 100% satisfied customers, and who do what they say they will do. First class job, with great sales team, punctual and professional installers and excellent help on sorting rebates, finance and the best system for my needs. They took the time to help me understand how things work, including the EV charger and app!

Paul from Venergy provided a comprehensive dive into he different options; both solar only and battery and solar. We opted for the battery system with the solar being installed straight away to a high standard even with our challenging roof.

I received 3 excellent quotes but Andrew at Venergy went the furthest to reassure me my shading issue was addressed and came up with a really good design which maximised winter production with least cost for 17kW. Installer Ben and crew did a great job squeezing all the panels in. They look beautiful - the inverter and battery likewise. Venergy quickly adjusted the quote to account for the new battery rebate. I got a sense of quality and attention to detail from all my interactions with Venergy, as well as the install itself, and heartily recommend them.

The quoting process was personalised and provided options to meet my requirements.The installation was seamless, on time and the staff were professional and quality focused.Venergy provided high level customer service who organised every aspect, from information on option, installation and grid and software connection.I would highly recommend Venergy.
Salesmen was great, explained everything, was not pushy.Price quoted was good (half the price of another company).Installation was quick.. tradies were great.
Great service. Very good information. Informed all the way. They were not the cheapest but had the best service.
installers were fantastic venergy took care of everything including down loading the app for me very happy with everything

My experience with Venergy has been really great, and in particular a big shout out to Paul from sales. James was great too and was very fast to respond to a follow up query on the after installation side of things, resolved it the next day - thank you so much. From my initial query to installation or the panels and ev charger, I am very happy with the service provided.  Paul is awesome after sales - provided and still does amazing customer service, helpful, informative, knowledge is amazing - answering all my calls, even on weekends! questions and issues, listening/addressing all my queries/concerns and everything proceeded smoothly - very thankful . It has been almost a month since we had our solar system installed and everything is working as expected.Also, I was blown away when I spoke to SA power networks -  when I called them to check about their fine print with flexible exports, being on 3 phase and more info on how the wifi worked, they placed VEnergy in very high regards - respect…Highly recommend Venergy!

Got my first $0 electricity bill after solar panel and battery installation. Couldn’t be more happier.From installers who said solar panels cannot be installed on our roof top to others who quoted for a less kW system, VEnergy worked with what we got and helped to install maximum panels possible for a 9.6kW system.The sales person was extremely knowledgeable, helpful and polite.Will 100% recommend VEnergy.Thanks to solar quotes for the guidance.
Venergy were really good with their customer service . James was able to answered all my questions . The installation was done without any hassle . A through professional installation.
A couple of small issues had to be resolved. Was rectified in reasonable time
Very happy with the quotation and the information provided about the system. The installers were polite and professional, while the battery and app have been easy to work with.

The sales process and quoting was quick and they provided all the information I needed both by email and explained it over the phone. I was pleasantly surprised that they followed up with phone calls to introduce each member of the team and do proper handovers as it progressed through the process. I'm in the final stages of meter configuration with the energy retailer, so far it's been a very easy process.

I received a call from Paul Reynolds of Venergy and went through the process of the systems he recommended. After a thorough briefing, he sent a quote for 3 options. I had a discussion with my son and decided on second option which was for a6.6kw system with hybrid inverterThe installation was scheduled for today 31st January from 7am. They arrived promptly and went ahead with the installation. Staff members were polite and efficientUpon completion , I was asked to download the iCloudSolar app and shown how the systems work. I was also advised to call them if I need further assistance. I am now waiting for official commissioning of the systems in 10 working days time. Very pleased with the whole process which went smoothly

Venergy provided excellent customer service during the quote process. After accepting their quote out of 4 quotes received they arranged an installation date promptly, the install was done within a day including the dismantling of the old solar system. The Inspector has just visited and signed off and turned on the new system. So very happy with the process from quote to install and can now enjoy the power being generated by the new larger solar system.
Customer service was very good, felt engaged and informed at every step. Installation was performed very smoothly and smartly. Very happy with the whole experience.

It was really great dealing with Venergy. They helped me with all my questions (and I had a lot!) and when it came time to install, the guys were really great to deal with. They even helped replace roof tiles that were cracked by taking ones from under the solar panels and putting them where the cracked tiles were, and putting spares I had (of a different colour) under the solar panels. So they didn't just install the solar, but improved my roof too!After the install, there was a weird buzzing noise coming from the solar inverter. I sent an email to my sales person, got a call from them, and a few hours later, they remotely updated the configuration of the inverter and solved the issue. Now it's working flawlessly. I highly recommend them.

They were the first company to call me after I have submitted quote requests.Our consultant Todd, took his time to explain how the system works and has convinced me that they are dedicating the cost to quality installation service and customer service.He also showed his passion to help make the whole process smooth and speedy, in which they have made it happen on time despite my tight schedule so that I could enjoy the rebates fully.On the day of installation, 3 technicians arrived on time and finished the whole process in 4 hours. They have also cleaned up the area and collected the rubbish. They have taught me how to use the app and everything went smoothly.
They were punctual, polite and prompt.  No drama whatsoever.  They were always available to answer questions.

The initial sales person (Mark) was exceptional. When it came to explaining the process and what they took care of he provided more detail and information than the other consultations I had. Whilst no doubt the other companies offered the same thing, Venergy provided a very helpful and informative first conversation which set the tone. Before receiving any quotes back, I said to my partner, I already know who we are getting our install from.The team were super professional during the install, were extremely courteous, great at explaining the little things when asked questions. couldn't recommend them enough.
Could not fault there service ..Discussed all options regarding locations of inverter/piping etc.

Good customer service, polite and efficient. They were punctual and communicated well about when they would arrive and what was needed from me. Instillation was quick and they organised for the meter to be changed by my provider.

From the initial quote proposal to post installation follow up I have felt confident in my choice to purchase rooftop Solar Panels from VENERGY.   The price is competitive,  installation is prompt and professional and the follow up service is reassuring.The friendly installing electricians provided information regarding the app to monitor the energy production of my Panels which are happily supplying green energy to the grid.

A very professional organisation from start to end. Sales person (Paul) explains things very well and recommended the appropriate system and battery. Installation went well apart from accidental damage to our ceiling which they then sent someone out to repair once we had raised it promptly. System working well and to date we have not used any energy from the grid. Expecting zero dollar bills in the future!

VEnergy has been amazing in communication, outing what to expect at each stage of the process. The team that did the install were prompt, polite and got the job done quickly and neatly. They took time to answer questions. All of the rubbish was taken away including my old system and water solar panels. Overall very happy to date.
Great customer sales and service,Competitive quoteQuality productsVery happy

Venergy installed our system in December 2022, install was efficient, on time and very tidy. After nearly 2 years it continues to perform as promised.Recently decided to change energy providers and needed some info for the sign up, contacted Matt who remembered the install and was more than happy to help with my questions even though there was no opportunity for new business at the time.I have and will continue to recommend Venergy to anyone that asks me about solar given my experience with the team, and the way my system delivers.Keep up the excellent work !Thanks Shane

Venergy were very responsive when the request for quote went out and rang to discuss aspects and options. I had provided a fair amount of information and I felt they had listened to that and responded with an effective design. Very happy with installers who were both quick and effective (Cowlec).The rep at Venergy was able to come up with alternatives very quickly and were receptive to calls and queries. Post install everything happened with minor involvement on my part. The smart monitor allows easy tracking of kw produced and I am pleased with what it is producing.

I got 2 referrals from Solar Quotes and 1 of my own. They all ended up quoting very similar systems with very similar pricing but the reason I went with Venergy was they listened to what I wanted and gave me 3 system options.they answered every question and concern in a timely manner.They have a very systematic system to let you know what is going on and what to expect next with time frames.as Venergy are based in SA (I am in VIC) they used a install partner that were very professional.they removed my old 6kw system and installed the new 17.6Kw in 1.5 days.the electrical inspection was 2 days latter and I was online tracking my power .I am very happy with the whole experience and thank you to Solar quotes for the information on his website, YouTube videos so I could feel empowered to ask the right questions and understand the answers.

Venergy offered the most complete service with a competitive quote. I was kept up to date with the progress and when the installation started the crew was great, punctual professional, tidy and happy to answer my questions. New smart meter was installed the day after. Unfortunately, the work could not be completed because wrong connectors between the inverter and battery had been supplied. Fine, I was happy to wait till the following week. I'm still waiting for the inverter to be connected to the battery because I discovered, after I called to chase up, that the people who start the job need to complete the work but it turns out they are on leave. Manager immediately offered a $200 gift card as recompense but I still have no ETA for completion.
Truly fantastic customer service and detailed advice. Very helpful.The total process was seamless with very little work to complete myself, as Venergy organised everything.
Care of planning. Came back several times to reconsider. Good installers.

Sales/quoting was fantastic, so were the reviews of the installer, these were the main reasons I went with this installer. Wasn’t too fussed with price, I went with the installer with the best reviews.What I wasn’t told was that the installer sub-contracts some of their work out. Very disappointed that this was the case, considering I based the selection of the company on their reviews, not an unknown subbie.Would not have selected this company if I knew this was the case.Electricians left cable ties, offcuts of wires and pieces of cardboard in my garden, how hard is it to clean that up?Sparkies didn’t use any kind of edge protection when installing roof panels, glad they didn’t fall off the roof and hurt themselves. Luckily Worksafe weren’t doing their rounds…Would not recommend the company I purchased through (Venergy Pakenham), you had me at sales, lost me at sub-contracted install.

After extensive research, and a recommendation from Finn Peacock, we reached out to Venergy to explore a solar and battery solution for our home. Rebecca from Venergy promptly met with us just a couple of days after our initial contact. Her knowledge and proactive approach immediately impressed us. The quotes she provided were thorough and professional. Additionally, we were contacted by Venergy’s general manager, James, who discussed our energy investment with us, making us feel valued rather than just another sale. Onsite, the installation team was also helpful and pleasant. We have thoroughly enjoyed tracking our usage on the Sungrow app and have no hesitation in recommending Venergy to family and friends.

James is an excellent communicator and helped me along the way with every part of the process, even when I wanted to make changes more than once. He made the changes on the fly and I got the new quote within seconds.The installers arrived on time, were professional and polite, and dis an excellent job.I'm very happy with the whole transaction and would happily recommend.

After using Solar Quotes to help us find a solar installer, we are very satisfied with the outcome. Venergy customer service team made all the difference in our final decision (thank you Rebecca). Assistance with government solar loans was fantastic and any questions I had on the system and battery were expertly handled. Installation went seamlessly.

I called Venergy four a quote as a second quote on a system i had already basically made my mind on. After speaking to Aaron for about 10 min it was very clear to me that i was dealing with a professional company. I was given a quote via email that day, based on what could be seen via satellite pics of my house.I rang back about 2 days later, with a few questions , re, the position of the battery etc. Aaron asked if it was OK if he was to send an employee to my property to inspect battery location and a few other questions. Later that day I received a call from James and locked in an appointment the next day.The next day James MacGowan arrived on time and with another person. I was flattered to find out that James was the General manager and the other person was the owner of Venergy. I FELT SPECIAL.I asked all my questions and again it was obvious to me he knew his stuff, and was polite to boot.I ordered our new solar/battery system during their visit.When installation day arrived, two installers from Venergy arrived on time well presented and polite. as they worked they were clean,and respected my house. It took two days to complete the installation. When they left after the first day everything was done to ensure that all was tidy and neat.After completion of the installation, everything was cleaned up and was as if they haven’t been there.Now that i have had the system for a little while , I couldn’t be more thrilled with the performance of the unit.On a couple occasions i have had to call James with queries , he has ALWAYS promptly answered the phone and answered all my questions.Again the feeling of being a special customer has never left meI cannot recommend Venergy high enough. If I moved house and wanted another system, they would be the only ones who i would call. Probably not even get a second quote. Sometimes service and piece of mind is worth everything

The whole solar sale and install process was seamless and informative.Firstly I dealt with a real professional in Paul Reynolds whose knowledge and experience in this field was obvious and extensive, not pushy and readily answered all queries I had. Paul took care of everything once we made commitment to purchase, this relieved all stress from the process and was much appreciated. Matt and the boys took care of the install, they battled the weather which didn’t make it easy on our steeply pitched roof but did so without any fuss. Once the install was completed the handover was very thorough and informative and gave me opportunity to ask any questions I had. It was all very clear and easy to understand. Thanks to all.

Venergy have bent over backwards to make sure we got a great system. We have been impressed by the design and quality the of system, but especially the install which needed some holes cut in walls and some complex cable routing - all of which was perfectly patched and painted when the job was complete. There were a couple of changes that we needed in the backup circuitry afterwards, and this was seen to promptly and to our complete satisfaction. All the people that we’ve met at the company have been really great, and quick long-term employees - nothing has been too much trouble. There’s something very good going on culturally at Venergy.
From start to finish it was a great experience.Good people, who are good at their job are very hard to find. When everyone you deal with  are switched on, it’s like winning lotto.

Communicating with Venergy was easy and simple, they answered all my questions as a completely new person to this field, any changes or concerns they also notified me immediately and were patient with walking me through each step.The installation went smoothly, the crew Venergy used for my area, Cowlec, was polite, tidy and punctual, they arrived, worked quickly and carefully, everything looks good. The inspection afterwards gave it a clear, too, although they forgot to labels a few switches, they came back the next day after inspection to label everything and double check to make sure all is well.They were more expensive than some other quotes but with the service and the solar system starting off well, I have high hopes it'd keep working great going forward.

I received 3 quotes and went with the Venergy. Even though the price quoted was higher but they were the ones that were returning calls and answering to my queries within the same day. Installers arrived earlier than the scheduled time and they were friendly and polite. After installation was completed, the managers from Venergy was constantly in touch with updates to the grid connections. I was very happy and pleased with their professionalism.

Venergy were amazing throughout the whole solar installation, they were extremely helpful with coming up with a solar configuration to suit my budget/requirements. The installation process was smooth and efficient, they did a fantastic job of installing the panels on the roof and made sure I was happy with where the inverter was being installed prior to installation. Customer service and after sales support has been great. Overall a quality and very attractive installation which is saving me loads of money!
Very happy with my system. Professional company and good value.

It started with a quote which was explained and adapted to my needs. Two weeks after approval, the installation was done and running. All went well and the system works perfectly and as I intended. Great job from all.

I picked the company that quoted the panels/inverter I preferred with the best price. I didn't want solaregde, but I get why ppl do.Quoting: took a lot of time with me asking loads of questions. Very responsive, but salesperson didn't have an eye for detail and sent me a diagram of proposed system with only 30 panels showing when quoting for 32. Another was adding an extra necessary component to quote at the 11th hour, increasing cost of system, as we were negotiating on price right before committing to buy.Install: loved the electrician crew Venergy used. Cowlec were punctual, polite, and I'm really happy with the install. As other people may have had, one of the proposed labels didn't fit on the 2nd storey roof and we had to put it in a less good spot and it produces very poorly. This is my one regret about the whole thing.

Was happy with my experience with Venergy, they provided me with a quote, which I compared to the others, and they changed it as I requested to suit the spec I was looking for. The Solar install itself only took a day, the installers were very professional and got the job done with a minimum of fuss. An overall positive experience so far, the performance of the system has been good to date, will be interested to see how if performs over the winter months.

I found the sales/quoting process very friendly and helpful (for all three of my quotes). Everything happened exactly when I was told it would happen, and I was kept up to date with the process all the way through. The installers were friendly, made time to come out earlier in the week to fit the panel brackets so the process on the day would be quicker, and they left the place neat and clean.Venergy have arranged all the connections with the energy supply company, and they will continue to monitor my system to make sure it is working at optimal efficiency. I couldn't be happier with the result!

Amazing company!Fast, affordable, friendly and understanding customer service from James with the initial quoting, no questions were too hard and he was very transparent.Installation happened very quickly after agreeing to the quote, installation team were down to earth, friendly and so careful with the installation on our brand new house. They were tidy and left nothing behind but great installation of our solar system.After care has been fantastic, can always call and get clarity on our system if we are unsure and have an online app platform we can monitor our system from.Since August 2023 we have only had 1 electricity bill of $175 compared to our original bills of $1500+ each quarter. Has been well worth every cent for our family of 5!Thanks Venergy!
Great communicationEasy to understand processQuick response to any questionsEverything outlined in email as well as verbalGood reviewsLocal supplier

Right from the first enquiry, Venergy was on the ball. I dealt directly with James McGowan and the customer service couldn't have been better. I was kept in the loop through each stage of the process. Installation was tidy and thorough. Everything was taken care of and nothing was too much trouble. It's not every day you're treated as a valued customer. I certainly was, and can highly recommend Venergy on the basis of my own experience.

We had a 7.98KW system installed by Venergy mid last year. We could not have been happier with the whole experience, from the very first phone contact through to the completion of the job and follow up to ensure we were satisfied.Craig and James were an absolute pleasure to deal with and nothing was too much trouble. If they weren’t available when we called, they would call us back the same day.The installation team were legends and despite the forecast temperature for the day being 40 degrees, they arranged with us to start at the crack of dawn, and powered through the heat until the job was done. Also the cleanest tradies we have ever seen, even asking for a vacuum cleaner to tidy up after themselves.Our system has been everything that was promised and we have happily recommended Venergy to family and friends based on our overwhelmingly positive experience.

Hi ,we were impressed with Mike from Venergy who came out and looked at the property and discussed what we were looking for. A few hiccups with communication after that with head office re arrangements / filling out forms. No biggie but we have installed solar twice before with other companies and it was seamless.The installers were young blokes but very polite , seemed organised and kept us informed of what they were going to do. Install was on 22 Jan 2024. Subsequently thru Solar Quotes we became aware of the Goodwe recall and I emailed Venergy on the 24.1.24 to ask if our installed Goodwe MS30 inverter was OK or was "updated"prior too install ?No-one from Venergy has yet replied to that email.Also I haven't received any Certificate of Compliance for the electrical work.That always used to be a thing , so not sure if it is still expected ? So here I am, paid my money, got something installed but have to do more work to chase up this company to get assurances about things they are supposed to be the experts o , cos I'm not - that's why I subscribed to Solar Quotes! Thank you Finn :)I have downgraded my star reviews due to uncertainty of the inverter installed.Dave

Very good experience from Venergy, Paul was excellent and answered all my queries.Install was good, the boys sweated  it out on the roof in the Adelaide sun/heat, the technician confirmed a fault with the HomeKit monitoring and arranged for a new one to be sent out and reinstalled.. so far so good with solar production and monitoring. Can’t wait to see the savings!!Hopefully we can add a battery in the future for more benefits.8kw 3 phase inverter with 10kw of panels !Thanks Venergy!

- Sales/Quote was great, I felt comfortable throughout and they did a site inspection before I paid the deposit to confirm the install could be done to my satisfaction (low profile, not visible from the street, conduits hidden)- The install was a bit bumpy, looks great from the street, low profile however I was not expecting them to cut my plumbing vent pipe and lay the solar panels over the ventilation pipe. Also a mounting bracket was laid right onto a data cable used for my heating/cooling which when I raised the issue of my heating cooling not working to the installers they denied any wrongdoing. I had to call for a heating/cooling technician to come out and verify this was the cause, send pictures to prove this was the case to the installers who then came back the day after I alerted them to it and rectified the issue immediately. I went 1 week without a heater/cooler as a result.

Venergy provided a very good experience throughout the solar installation and quoting process.The staff were efficient and friendly with good product knowledge.They were on time and informative with the installation, worked effectively and kept me up to date on all steps along the way.

The sales/quoting process was very comprehensive. Venergy agreed on removal and installation to be on separate days to allow us to clean the roof (it is very dirty under the old panels) although it did cost us extra.The existing panes have been removed.  The footing roof & cable entry holes were well sealed.The customer service is ok - we received only one half hours notice of the crew attending for removal. All went well & the site was left tidy.

My partner and I had a great experience with Venergy when we had our solar installed on our new home. So much so, we looked no further when we decided to get a battery added to the system. They made the process easy and communicated well. Installation was prompt, with no delays or issues and the installer was great to deal with. 100% recommend.

Excellent - way more sophisticated and professional than what I was expecting. The sales and quoting process was extremely thorough. Installation guys were very professional and clean. It was a great experience. Can't recommend Venergy enough.

I’ve been happy with the process overall. Venergy was responsive and worked through my questions thoroughly and professionally. Their offering was clearer and simpler than the multiple options put up by other companies, which had limited explanation of the relative practical benefits of each option or the rationale for their recommended option.  Venergy also weren’t pushy - unlike another company, no last minute special offers apparently designed to sway me into a quick decision after I’d indicated my timeframe for making a selection. The installation went smoothly- no surprises - and customer service has been positive. Still early days as the installation happened a couple of days ago and the grid connection is still in process, but so far, so good.

After a very negative quoting experience outside of "Solar Quotes' where they tried to sell me a very expensive system that was way more than I needed, I decided to take advantage of Solar Quotes to see if I could get a better experience.  And that's exactly what happened.  Quote/sales process was smooth and easy to navigate, and the installation was fabulous. The guys were punctual, friendly, tidy and very helpful.  The meter is being upgraded this week, and after that I'll know more, but the installdrs helped me find the right app, explained it all to me, and left me feeling confident and happy with the whole process.

The sales/quoting process was very good they were always very prompt with responses to my numerous questions.The installation team arrived on time, were very polite and went through the installation process in detail with me. When they left the site was very tidy.Everything was setup so system was connected to the grid on the day. They made sure monitoring apps were setup so I could see the system working before they left.

sales and business are the cowboys you warn against. They use the original contract as a starting point. Did not do a on site quote as requested through solar quotes. Called my wife dishonest when they couldn't install it over one day and didn't want to return the following day as promised. Ignored emails to confirm dates. Only want to talk by phone as to not be held accountable with a record of conversation. In my opinion.

Excellent Solar Company! We bought 2 Solar systems! We had a great experience with Venergy Solar. James was our Solar consultant, he was very easy to deal with, explained everything clearly, it was a first class experience! The installers on the day, Adam and Nick were amazing, they took care and of both of our homes and the installation looks great! We now recommend Venergy to all our family and friends, faultless experience 10/10. Thank you team Venergy!

I'm spending time and money to fix these issue. Most people would not notice nor care but I'm particular with risk to my network. In terms of energy supply the system works very well, my issues are with cyber security risk.The issues I'm working through include:* Security - Both the inverter and the energy meter expose WIFI access points even after connected to my network and working (this means that my neighbours can see a couple of "Solar_WiFiNNNNN" networks). Goodwe documentation does say change the network password but still it ought not be still exposing an access point on the same channel as my APs. It does not help that there is a published default password.* Security - The system exposes on my network setup web pages and SSH connections that both use the username "admin" and password "admin" (anybody can google this). So far I do not see how to change this password. So anybody who can access the network (e.g. a bored 10 year old) can, potentially, do bad things unless I partition the network.* Connectivity - I have a home automation system. It can talk directly to the inverter but Goodwe has not published how to directly talk to the energy meter. So ... I need to get information from their web site. This means I cannot see immediate data and I'm dependent on a company's web service. That is, it does not work "local". If I had known this when reviewing the quote I would not have chosen a Goodwe system.So, Invensys are great but I regret going for a Goodwe system.
